take_over_clash.title: Tigo system {systemid} is set up twice
take_over_clash.description:
Tigo system {systemid} is set up in this integration and in the legacy Tigo integration. Its sensors were not taken over from the legacy integration, as this one has them already: {entities}.

To continue the legacy sensors and their history, delete the system here and add it again; the sensors of this integration so far keep their history under their own entity ids. To keep the sensors of this integration, delete the system from the legacy integration instead.
